title: USSTRATCOM annual congressional posture statement NC3 series, 2024-2026
relationship_scope: annual statements from the same institutional command lineage; useful for time-bounded change tracking but not independent corroboration of repeated NC3 program propositions

release_chronology.description: Describes NC3 enterprise modernization and E-4B/E-6B recapitalization as part of the command's 2024 posture.
Adds the Detect-Decide-Direct mission framework and names SAOC, E-130J TACAMO, satellite communications, warning/tracking, ground NC3, and cyber/data priorities.

Updates the modernization picture with the NC3 Enterprise Center, SAOC, E-130J TACAMO recapitalization, E-6B Airborne Command Post replacement, resilient satellite communications, missile warning/tracking, ground NC3, cyber, and AI/ML integration.

interpretation_guard: Repeated language or program descriptions across these annual statements are same-institution longitudinal evidence, not three independent confirmations. Time-specific additions may document change in the command's public posture but still require underlying program/governance records for independent source support.
notes: Use this family to compare public NC3 posture over time. Do not infer classified requirements, controlled directives, detailed platform procedures, or actual operational use from the posture series.
